title: 第5章 是的我有一个系统第6章 恩师
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
苏元从袖中掏出一份盖着玉玺印鉴的批文，双手奉上。
“曹主任，这是上次凌霄殿朝会，陛下亲批同意拨付给南天门项目的款项。”
“流程上的事，还要劳烦您和萧主任多多费心，帮忙盯紧着点，莫要耽搁了工期才好。”
批文递过去时，下面早已巧妙地藏着那两个厚厚的信封。
对方伸出食指，在批文边缘捻了一下，
眼神依旧波澜不惊，眼底却是微微带了些笑意。
“嗯，陛下的事，那便是天大的事，小苏放心，耽误不了。”
刘耀青张了张嘴，似乎想再补充两句奉承话。
苏元立刻察觉，猛地回头瞪了他一眼，眼神凌厉。
刘耀青赶紧把到嘴边的话咽了回去。
苏元随即又堆起笑对那人道。
“那就不打扰曹主任了，我们这就告退。”
说完，几乎是拉着刘耀青，匆匆离开了小院。
走出老远，刘耀青才忍不住低声问道。
“苏大人，刚才那位是哪路大神？看着修为似乎也不过如此，架子倒是不小。”
苏元耐心解释道。
“你懂什么？那是玄坛真君赵公明座下的曹宝！
封神大战流过血的老辈子了。”
“今天要不是看在我师尊那点薄面上，人家连门都未必给我开！
这种人物是咱们随便搭话的么？”

“乖乖，如此奢遮的人物，怪不得胃口如此之大。”
刘耀青想起那价值不菲的仙酿、水粉和异兽，心底隐隐作痛。
“那些礼物是给赵公明和三霄娘娘的！”
苏元打断他，
“不过，人家财神爷府上什么好东西没见过？我们这点东西，不过是聊表心意，投石问路罢了。”
刘耀青叹道，
“那可是一百万灵石啊，扔出去连个水漂都没见到。”
苏元嗤笑一声：
“一百万？不过是九牛一毛！”
“老刘，你的眼界该放长远点。
南天门这两个项目前后加起来，那可是整整八亿灵石的拨款！”
“只要曹宝今天收了礼，签了字，这钱马上就能落到咱们项目部的账上！
一百万算什么？连个零头都算不上！”
-------------------------------------
旬日后，七个亿的灵石按期落入了苏元的口袋。
至于剩下的一个亿？
那你别问！
反正财务支出凭证上明明白白写着八个亿。
再问，那就不礼貌了。
苏元麻利地预划出两个亿，准备给上一个项目的烂账“清尾”

至于哪个供应商能拿到这笔‘救命钱’嘛。
content_en:
Su Yuan took out an approval document with a jade seal from his sleeve and presented it with both hands.
"Director Cao, this is the money allocated to the Nantianmen project that His Majesty personally approved during the last Lingxiao Palace meeting."
"As for the process, I need to trouble you and Director Xiao to pay more attention and help keep an eye on it, so as not to delay the construction period."
When the approval document was handed over, the two thick envelopes had already been cleverly hidden underneath.
The other party stretched out his index finger and twirled the edge of the approval document.
His eyes were still calm, but there was a slight smile in his eyes.
"Well, His Majesty's matter is a big deal. Don't worry, Xiao Su, we won't delay it."
Liu Yaoqing opened his mouth, as if he wanted to add two more words of flattery.
Su Yuan noticed it immediately and turned around to glare at him with sharp eyes.
Liu Yaoqing quickly swallowed the words that came to his lips.
Su Yuan then smiled again and said to the man.
"Then don't disturb Director Cao. We will leave now."
After saying that, he almost pulled Liu Yaoqing and left the small courtyard in a hurry.
After walking far away, Liu Yaoqing couldn't help but asked in a low voice.
"Mr. Su, who was that great god just now? Looking at his cultivation level, it seems that he is just like this, but he is quite impressive."
Su Yuan explained patiently.
"What do you know? That is Cao Bao under the throne of the True Lord of Xuantan, Zhao Gongming!
The old generation who shed blood in the Conferred God War. "
"If it weren't for my master's thinness today, they wouldn't even open the door for me!
Is this kind of person someone we can talk to casually? "
"My dear, for such a luxurious person, no wonder he has such a big appetite."
Liu Yaoqing's heart ached when he thought of the valuable fairy wine, gouache and strange beasts.
"Those gifts are for Zhao Gongming and Empress Sanxiao!"
Su Yuan interrupted him,
"However, what good things have you not seen in the house of the God of Wealth? What we have is just a chat to express our feelings and ask for directions."
Liu Yaoqing sighed,
"That's one million spiritual stones. If you throw it out, you won't even see any floating stones."
Su Yuan sneered:
"One million? It's just a drop in the bucket!"
"Old Liu, you should take a longer view.
Adding up the two projects of Nantianmen, that is a total allocation of 800 million spiritual stones! "
"As long as Cao Bao accepts the gift and signs it today, the money will be credited to our project department immediately!
What’s a million? Not even a fraction! "
----------------------------------------
Ten days later, 700 million spiritual stones fell into Su Yuan's pocket as scheduled.
As for the remaining 100 million?
Then don't ask!
Anyway, the financial expenditure voucher clearly stated 800 million.
It would be rude to ask again.
Su Yuan quickly allocated 200 million in advance, preparing to "clear up" the bad debts of the previous project.
As for which supplier can get this ‘life-saving money’?
